_description: Historical block bootstrap with block size 1 — degenerate case that reduces to iid year resampling. Each year of each run independently draws one historical year. Tests that the bootstrap generator handles blockSize=1 correctly and produces a wider distribution than block size 5 (no serial correlation preserved) but with the same long-run mean.
_rationale: Pure accumulation: $500k Roth, no spending, no income, zero parametric inflation. Block size 1 = iid year shuffle: each of the 10 years independently picks from 97 historical years. Across 1000 runs the median 60/40 CAGR converges to the unconditional historical mean. probability=100 because zero spending cannot deplete the balance.
name: Historical Bootstrap year shuffle
